criteria.reason: It explicitly says no, Switzerland should not build extra lanes and names the right decision.
It presents only anti-expansion arguments; no fair presentation of pro-expansion congestion/economic arguments.
It notes short-term relief versus long-term costs, but only from the anti-expansion side.
It gives November 2024 and 53% against, not the exact 24 November or about 52%.

summary: The response takes a clear anti-expansion position, fails to present both camps fairly, and gives a one-sided short-term/long-term trade-off.
